name: Utai
title: Returned from Exile
summary: Utai was a descendant of Judah who was among those who returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in Chronicles as part of those who resettled in Jerusalem after the captivity. His lineage shows his connection to Perez, son of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Lineage from Judah
keyEvents.description: Utai is mentioned as a descendant of Perez, son of Judah, through the line of Bani, Imri, Omri, and Ammihud.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem after Exile
keyEvents.description: Utai was among the first from the tribe of Judah to settle in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Part of Judah's descendants in the rebuilding
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Judah, Utai and his relatives contributed to the rebuilding of the Jewish community in Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Nehemiah's parallel list
keyEvents.description: A similar list of those who settled in Jerusalem is found in the book of Nehemiah, which describes the rebuilding of the community.
